notes.title: 08/24 (Sun) Update - Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content: [p]▽Bug Fixes[/p][p] - Fixed an issue where the item location indicator icon would disappear when using Photo Mode.[/p][p] - Fixed an issue where Freya's "Sniff" ability would not respond correctly.[/p][p] - Fixed an issue where Freya would fall through the map if the locker caught cutscene was triggered before the locker door was fully closed.[/p][p] - Fixed an issue where items could be used from inside a locker.[/p][p] - Fixed an issue where the location of the PC that needs to be booted up was duplicated in the Energy Drink ending route.[/p][p] - Fixed an issue where the puzzle would not proceed if an item was placed on the toilet and then removed.[/p][p] - Corrected the display to show the number of items placed on the toilet to meet the objective.[/p][p] - Fixed an issue where a different motion would appear on the title screen when the main entrance ending had not been cleared.[/p][p][/p][p]▽Improvements[/p][p] - Added the ability to view current option information by pressing Tab in Ranking Mode.[/p][p] - Improved the visibility of the leaderboard in Ranking Mode.[/p][p] - Applied a 3D effect to Freya's skill failure sound.[/p][p] - Adjusted the interaction time for the "Clumsy Skills" option from 5 seconds to 2.5 seconds.[/p][p] - Improved Freya's chase logic to resolve persistent errors (performance enhancement).[/p]

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where the item location indicator icon would disappear when using Photo Mode.
- Fixed an issue where Freya's "Sniff" ability would not respond correctly.
- Fixed an issue where Freya would fall through the map if the locker caught cutscene was triggered before the locker door was fully closed.
- Fixed an issue where items could be used from inside a locker.
- Fixed an issue where the location of the PC that needs to be booted up was duplicated in the Energy Drink ending route.
- Fixed an issue where the puzzle would not proceed if an item was placed on the toilet and then removed.
- Corrected the display to show the number of items placed on the toilet to meet the objective.
- Fixed an issue where a different motion would appear on the title screen when the main entrance ending had not been cleared.

tags.feature: - Added the ability to view current option information by pressing Tab in Ranking Mode.

tags.balance_change: - Adjusted the interaction time for the "Clumsy Skills" option from 5 seconds to 2.5 seconds.

notes.title: 08/20 (Wed) Update - Map Revisions & Feature Additions/Improvements
notes.content: [p]○ Feature Additions and Modifications[/p][p] - Low Stress Mode added (Freya's location will be displayed).[/p][p] - Increased flashlight brightness.[/p][p] - Transfer Student's running speed increased from 600 to 620.[/p][p] - Removed the pattern where Freya randomly opens lockers.[/p][p] - Changed the player's stamina recovery speed from 5 to 8.[/p][p][/p][p]○ Map Revisions[/p][p] - Added a passage from the end of the Annex to the Library.[/p][p] - Added stairs leading to the Central Garden from the staircase connected to the 3rd floor.[/p][p] - Added stairs leading from the Annex hallway to the 1st floor.[/p][p] - Added a passage from the Chemistry Room to the Teachers' Office.[/p][p][/p][p]○ Bug Fixes[/p][p] - Fixed an issue where the puzzle would progress if the dog whistle item was dropped multiple times.[/p][p] - Fixed an issue where some objects would disappear when re-watching the cutscene in the ending collection after playing through the Barbecue ending.[/p][p] - Fixed an issue that occurred when objects were placed too quickly on the Bathroom Ghost ending route.[/p][p] - Fixed a bug with the clay dog marker.[/p][p] - Corrected the Annex ladder marker position.[/p][p] - Fixed an issue where Freya would move while opening a door.[/p][p] - Fixed an issue in Endless Mode with the "Clumsy Skills" option where a note would be automatically read 5 seconds after picking up the Annex ladder.[/p][p] - Fixed an issue where the results screen would reappear after pressing ESC on the Infinite Mode results screen.[/p]
